avis.texte: I'll admit, I don't follow the directions. I use this as a makeup remover only, then rinse, then follow with cleanser. I love it like this. It melts my mascara off with ease. It really breaks down my makeup well and it doesn't dry me out. I've never experienced burning eyes or anything like that. I think if I used it as instructed, I wouldn't like it thought because it does leave a film, probably to moisturize so you only need one step.

This product has been life changing for me! It has helped me with the one thing that keeps me from being consistent with a skin care routine, taking sunscreen and makeup off EVERY night. Yes, some products do a better job leaving my face feeling fully cleansed, BUT they involve water and standing at my sink, both of which I hate most of the time. This requires neither! This is great for disabled people, traveling, camping, the list goes on. I have very sensitive skin and this has never irritated my skin, dried it out, or caused breakouts; and it does a good job cleaning my face until I can give it a more thorough wash in the shower. The only down side is it can leave a little bit of a film if you don't spend enough time wiping it off, and do NOT use water.
Unfortunately a return for me. It did get most of the makeup off if you follow the instructions doing the dry removal, but my face felt weird once I started washing my face after the makeup removal.
Not quite sure what the point of this is? To waste money? Mission accomplished. Will not repurchase!

Honeslty im very disappointed in CeraVe for this one. It removed most of my face makeup, and didnt feel stripping to my skin, but left a greasy film when i tried to rinse it off. (I know the directions say to wipe it off, but a good product product shouldn't lose that much efficacy if i rinse vs wipe). In my eyes, it stung. And it didnt remove my mascara very well. I use ultra hold Japanese mascara, to be fair, but again that shouldnt be a problem for a genuinely good product. I'm sticking to my other makeup remover, the Neutrogena makeup remover. At least i tried it, but there are much better makeup removers out there. CeraVe can do better

avis.titre: Did wonders for my skin barrier
avis.texte: I use this on dry skin and wipe off with a dry cotton pad and it does a great job of removing makeup and sunscreen without stripping my skin. I didn't realize how over drying my other cleansers were. Be sure to follow the instructions because it will not work with water. I personally love that I can use this dry and don't have to worry about washing my face before bed!

YALL READ THE PRODUCT DIRECTIONS 😭 use this DRY on your face and remove DRY with a towel or cotton round. If you attempt to use water it will work against you as it is oil based. It removed the most difficult waterproof mascara and left a perfect base for my face wash + rinse step. I never leave reviews, but as someone that HATES conventional makeup removers (micellar water burns me, neutrogena is soooo oily and filmy) this gets nothing but a perfect ten from me.

avis.titre: LOVE after tweaking how I use it
avis.texte: I see from other reviews that people are not a fan of this but I LOVE it... after making some adjustments. I use it as a pre-cleanser (& I don't follow the directions which says to just massage it on face & wipe off the product with no water). I massage it all over my face, including my eyes (which really helps with mascara and eye makeup removal) I ONLY wipe my eyes before I add a small amount of water + my normal face cleanser on top. Rub it all together, use a wet microfiber face cloth to wipe my face and voila! I'm left with clean, soft feeling skin before I move on to completing the rest of my skincare routine.

I thought a cream to water formula and the fact that the directions say "no need to rinse" sounded interesting. You absolutely must rinse. It leaves a greasy film and old makeup swirling around on your face. No clean feeling at all. I had to cleanse my face with a good cleanser afterward. Ew Since it doesnt clean your skin it's pointless. There are a ton of better makeup balms to use instead.

This has been working great for me. It breaks down my glittery eye makeup without disturbing my lash clusters. It goes from a light cream to a watery feel as opposed to oily/greasy balms. I always wipe this and other balms off before cleansing. I've never had a residue or anything. Wipe it off with some micellar water and/or makeup wipe and you'll be good to go

I didn't read the reviews before buying and I wish I would have. This product leaves a slimy film on my face, like I put Vaseline on my face, and I have to scrub to get it off. I unequivocally do not recommend.

avis.titre: Not an alternative for the cleansing balm
avis.texte: I bought this hoping it would be similar to the cleansing balm but with better packaging but it is not similar at all. The wiping does not work for my skin and unless you use an oil based cleanser afterward you will be left with a mess. Also does not remove makeup as well as the cleansing balm which is my absolute favorite so I will be sticking to that.

I love CeraVe products but this one totally missed the mark. It didn't really remove makeup and left a horrible weird residue on my face almost like vaseline. Made it more difficult to double cleanse with my favorite Foaming Cleanser also by CeraVe. Would not recommend at all - I really had high hopes because I want them to make a liquid makeup remover but this was NOT it.

Not for me! I don't really like "wiping" cleansers off my face, so I thought I would try rinsing- total disaster. It felt like my eyes wouldn't open because they were so goopy and I couldn't get the stuff off without wiping. May be good for camping

It doesn't remove all of the make up. I even mixed it with my cleansing oil to help. It left this film feeling on your face. I have to use foam cleanser twice to remove that feeling off of my face. Too bad!

I knew better than to cheat on my ride-or-die, Clinique Take the Day Off Balm. That product removes ALL my makeup except sometimes the most stubborn eyeliner. It doesn't sting my eyes either. I love Cerave and was excited to try this. It doesn't remove eye makeup very well at all. I need a second eye makeup remover. It also stings my eyes if I get it in my eyes, so I would have needed a second product to remove eye makeup for that reason as well. I don't lie, the "water" texture it turns into either. It does "ok" on face makeup, but I definitely need to do a second cleanse to make sure all my makeup is off.

I was so excited to try this, but I hated it. The formula is not comfortable to use, and even after using a lot of it, my makeup still wasn't completely removed. Even after double cleansing, I could still feel this on my skin after. Not great!

Be aware that this does not truly "melt" or rinse off as easily as a cleansing balm like I had hoped. I liked the form factor for shower use for face double cleanse rather than having to screw off a top and dip my finger in a balm container. But this left a petrolatum-like residue on the face that did not rinse cleanly or easily. The residue came off with use of face cleanser, so it may suit some people but I didn't care for it.
